title: The free-shipping gap
hook: Adding an item can remove shipping while raising the total you pay.

knows: that a model can declare hypothetical quantities
doesNotKnow: Compare total checkout cost when adding merchandise to reach a shipping threshold.

misconception: Free shipping means a lower checkout total.
objective: Compare total checkout cost when adding merchandise to reach a shipping threshold.

claims.text: Shipping costs €4 below €50. B adds exactly enough merchandise to reach €50. Scaled model; fictional policy; added goods optional.
claims.source: Declared hypothetical inputs and limits in resource-specs.json. No actual product, price, tariff, shelf-life, treatment or physical appliance specification is asserted. FC LH-1 (session 2, received by message): verified; see company/reviews/lifehacks-200/fact-check-LH1-2026-10-14.md.

claims.text: The stage's two results are computed by the printed expressions. At Basket=42€, A=€46 and B=€50. Geometry follows the declared dimension relationships. Other pictures use a fixed full scale across the slider range; continuous fills and arcs show relative amounts rather than literal object counts.
claims.source: src/lib/lifehacks/resource-specs.json contains this lesson's numeric AST; src/lib/lifehacks/resource-model.ts evaluates it. A=["+","x",["*",4,["-",1,["floor",["min",1,["/","x",50]]]]]]; B=["max","x",50]; x denotes Basket. At x=42, A=46, B=50. Values are fictional/ideal assumptions, not measurements. Display rounds to at most three decimals. Diagram scale: resourceGraphicScale in resource-model.ts takes the maximum modeled magnitude across both formulas and the declared slider range. For non-geometry figures, full-scale values are displayed; the scale stays fixed when the slider changes. Energy axis endpoints use resourceAxisEnd, including B=5×A hours in lh-watts-hours-trade; cylinder rx and ry both scale with radius in resourceCylinderDimensions.
